mapper.select: WITH m AS (INSERT INTO food_master(user_id,food_name) VALUES (1,#{name}) RETURNING master_id) INSERT INTO food_item(user_id,master_id, storage_type, freeze_type, frozen_at, status,quantity_amount,quantity_unit) VALUES (1,(SELECT master_id FROM m), #{storage}, #{freeze}, #{frozenAt,jdbcType=DATE}, #{status},CASE WHEN #{status}='DEPLETED' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,'개') RETURNING food_id

WITH m AS (INSERT INTO food_master(user_id,food_name) VALUES (1,#{name}) RETURNING master_id) INSERT INTO food_item(user_id,master_id, storage_type) VALUES (1,(SELECT master_id FROM m), 'FRIDGE') RETURNING food_id

SELECT food_id , m.food_name , storage_type , m.category , quantity_text , expired_at , purchased_at , opened_at , frozen_at , source_type , freeze_type , status , memo , i.created_at , i.updated_at , capacity_text , source_memo , sell_by_at , quantity_amount , quantity_unit FROM food_item i JOIN food_master m ON m.master_id=i.master_id WHERE food_id = #{id}
SELECT history_id , food_id , action_type , previous_storage_type , new_storage_type , quantity_text , changes_text , memo , created_at FROM food_history WHERE history_id = #{id}
